description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Holy)], [Awoken War Hero], [100% Critical (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Hero-King's Strike] to the user

description.name: Awoken War Hero
description.text: Spellblade and Knight abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade and Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Hero-King's Strike
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Holy] to the user after using two Fire, Ice, Lightning or Holy abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Lightning/Holy damage

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
